rationale: CR-001 verified resolved: has_new_routing in on_llm_end (agent_streaming_callback.py:230) is now derived from the raw response_tier/response_cost inputs rather than the metadata dict that _build_routing_update_fields seeds from existing_thought's prior state, matching the recommended fix exactly; confirmed by reading current source at reviewed head c5126fbb92d6f32e5f431da00b4e7b0ce268e613 and covered by a new regression test (test_on_llm_end_redundant_finalize_after_partial_routing_does_not_resend) that reproduces the partial-metadata-then-redundant-call sequence and asserts no resend and storage cleared. No other blocking findings existed in the prior verdict to verify; the only other changed_files entries are unrelated test reformatting in test_thought_consumer.py. business_review and standards_review carried forward unchanged from the prior verdict.

business_review.item: Dual on_llm_end invocation for the same run_id must not resend a redundant thought when no new routing metadata arrives, and must always leave the thought removed from storage afterward
business_review.notes: already_finalized/has_new_routing gate added; early-return deletes storage entry; test asserts single send + empty storage

business_review.item: A workflow LLM turn that never resolves a Switchyard-routed model results in exactly one persisted WorkflowExecutionStateThought row, not zero and not an IntegrityError
business_review.notes: covered end-to-end by real ThoughtQueue/ThoughtConsumer integration test plus the callback no-resend fix

business_review.item: A turn that does resolve Switchyard routing metadata on a later finalize call still gets that metadata stamped (no regression to the existing routed-model test)
business_review.notes: existing single-call routed-model test untouched; second-call has_new_routing=True path bypasses early return and still stamps routing

business_review.item: ThoughtConsumer.consume() receiving two items with the same id and in_progress=False does not raise and does not stop the consumer loop; subsequent items still processed
business_review.notes: _persisted_ids guard skips + logs duplicate and continues; test asserts save.call_count across 3 queued items

business_review.item: A genuinely unexpected save() failure (not a duplicate-id conflict) still propagates/logs as an error
business_review.notes: duplicate-id guard only short-circuits when id is in _persisted_ids; narrowed test still uses a fresh id and asserts propagation

business_review.item: An exception raised inside consume() is logged via the thread-pool Future's done-callback rather than silently vanishing
business_review.notes: _log_consumer_exception + future.add_done_callback added in run_consumer_in_thread_pool; test asserts logger.error called once

business_review.item: test_error_handling_during_save narrowed to genuinely unexpected save failure; new separate test covers the duplicate-id case
business_review.notes: docstring/comment narrowed, same assertions; new duplicate-id test added

business_review.item: New callback-level test: redundant on_llm_end for an already-finalized run_id does not resend duplicate content and removes the thought from storage
business_review.notes: test asserts single thought sent and storage entry cleared

business_review.item: New thread-pool-level test: a consume() exception is observed via the Future
New integration-style test: real ThoughtQueue wired to real ThoughtConsumer, duplicate-finalize, exactly one persisted row, consumer loop alive afterward
business_review.notes: sends duplicate finalize on one id then a second id; asserts save.call_count==2 and normal consume() return

business_review.item: Non-goal: no change to LangGraphEventAdapter's dual stop-branch structure
business_review.notes: langgraph_event_adapter.py does not appear in the diff

business_review.item: Non-goal: no change to BaseModelWithSQLSupport.save()/update() semantics generally
business_review.notes: base.py not in diff; guard is local to ThoughtConsumer.consume()

business_review.item: Non-goal: no general retry/backoff or resilience framework for the consumer thread pool
business_review.notes: only a logging done-callback added, no retry/restart logic

standards_review.notes: All 4 commit subjects in range match the documented 'EPMCDME-####: Description' format
Touched code uses modern union syntax, from __future__ import annotations, parameterized generics; no new untyped public function; each behavior change covered by a matching new test
New logging statements log only operation context (thought id, execution_state_id, exception object), no credentials/tokens; no auth or untrusted-input-parsing code touched

finding_status.notes: has_new_routing now derived from raw response_tier/response_cost (line 230) instead of the metadata dict seeded from existing_thought's prior state; matches the recommended fix. Verified at HEAD c5126fbb9 and covered by new test test_on_llm_end_redundant_finalize_after_partial_routing_does_not_resend, which reproduces the partial-metadata-then-redundant-call sequence.
